title: Homepage
summary: The homepage is the root document (index) of the site and usually its most visited page. It sets the bar for LCP, metadata and the shared nav and footer every other page reuses.

items.title: Hero in first section
items.detail: Put the hero image in the first section so EDS loads that section eagerly and treats its first image as the LCP candidate.

items.title: Lean first section
items.detail: Keep the first section to few blocks, and the payload before LCP under about 100kb from a single origin.

items.title: No root redirect chain
items.detail: Serve the homepage at / without hops like / to /en to /en/home; each redirect costs field performance.

items.title: Title and description
items.detail: Set title and description in the metadata block; otherwise AEM falls back to the first H1 and first long paragraph.

items.title: Share image
items.detail: Set the image metadata or add /default-meta-image.png so og:image is a deliberate picture when the URL is shared.

items.title: Nav and footer fragments
items.detail: Load nav and footer from their own documents asynchronously instead of copying them into the homepage content.

items.title: Canonical returns 200
items.detail: Make sure the homepage canonical URL answers with a 2xx status, not a redirect or a 404.

items.title: Organization schema
items.detail: Add site-wide Organization or WebSite JSON-LD from code (head.html or scripts.js) rather than per-page metadata.

items.title: Lighthouse 100
items.detail: Score 100 on mobile and desktop in PageSpeed Insights on the .aem.live URL and again on production.

title: Landing page
summary: A campaign or product landing page is a normal EDS document with a template and a few strong sections. It often runs experiments, so it needs a fast hero, delayed martech and variants kept out of the index.

items.title: Template metadata
items.detail: Set a template value in metadata so the body gets that class and auto blocking can build the page design.

items.title: One clear H1
items.detail: Give the page a single H1 that names the offer; it also becomes the title when none is set.

items.title: Hero is LCP
items.detail: Keep the hero in the first section with as few blocks as possible so the LCP image loads first.

items.title: Sections for layout
items.detail: Use section breaks and Section Metadata style for bands and backgrounds instead of nesting blocks.

items.title: Description and image
items.detail: Write a description and set the share image so campaign links unfurl with the right copy.

items.title: Campaign tags delayed
items.detail: Load campaign pixels and tag managers from consented.js in the delayed phase, never in head.html.

items.title: Experiment metadata
items.detail: For a test, add Experiment and Experiment Variants rows to the control page metadata with a unique ID.

items.title: Variants not indexed
items.detail: Set robots noindex,nofollow on challenger pages, for example on /experiments/** in bulk metadata.

title: Article
summary: An article (blog post, news, story) is default content with a title, hero image and byline taken from metadata. Its body must be in the initial HTML so search engines and LLM agents can read it.

items.title: H1 is the headline
items.detail: Author the headline as the only Heading 1; AEM uses it as the page title when no title metadata is set.

items.title: Body in initial HTML
items.detail: Keep the article text as authored content, not fetched by JavaScript, so the first crawl and LLM agents see it.

items.title: Hero image as LCP
items.detail: Place the lead image at the top of the first section so it is the LCP candidate.

items.title: Auto-blocked header
items.detail: Build the article header from the H1, first image and author and date metadata instead of an authored block.

items.title: Author and date
items.detail: Add author and publication-date metadata so the query index can pick them up for lists.

items.title: Description and tags
items.detail: Write a description and list tags in metadata; tags render as article:tag meta tags.

items.title: Article schema
items.detail: Generate Article JSON-LD from the visible H1, image, author and date, and keep it in line with the page.

items.title: Related links
items.detail: Link to related articles and the index page with descriptive anchor text, not read more.

title: Article index
summary: An article index lists pages from the query index, a JSON file AEM updates when pages are published. The list is rendered client-side, so the index config, its fields and the intro copy all need care.

items.title: Index covers the folder
items.detail: Scope the index definition with include and exclude paths so only real articles end up in the list.

items.title: Fields for cards
items.detail: Index the fields each card needs, such as title, image, description, date and lastModified.

items.title: Selectors match markup
items.detail: Write index selectors against the server markup, not the decorated DOM, and test them locally.

items.title: Reindex after changes
items.detail: Run Reindex in the Index Admin tool after adding or changing index properties.

items.title: Client-side list is fine
items.detail: Render the list from query-index.json in a block; listing pages have no canonical content of their own.

items.title: Authored intro
items.detail: Author the H1 and a short intro on the page so the index page still has content in its initial HTML.

items.title: Filter noindex pages
items.detail: Drop entries whose robots value is noindex when the content source cannot filter them out of the index.

items.title: Check one record
items.detail: Check how a single article is indexed with the Admin API index endpoint before debugging the list.

title: Product detail
summary: On an Adobe Commerce storefront on EDS, a product detail page (PDP) is rendered by the product-details drop-in from catalog data. Its SEO depends on metadata and JSON-LD published server-side, since the product loads in the browser.

items.title: Server-side metadata
items.detail: Publish product metadata to EDS so title, description and og tags are in the first HTML, not only after JS.

items.title: Full tag set
items.detail: Include title, description, og:title, og:image, og:url and og:product:price:amount and currency on every PDP.

items.title: Product JSON-LD
items.detail: Add Product, BreadcrumbList and rating JSON-LD; one invalid annotation makes Google drop all of them.

items.title: Generate metadata
items.detail: Use the PDP Metadata Generator to build a bulk metadata sheet from Catalog Service data.

items.title: Lowercase SKU URLs
items.detail: Build links with getProductLink so URLs follow /products/{urlKey}/{sku} with a lowercase SKU.

items.title: Canonical to parent
items.detail: Point configurable variants to the parent product canonical, and never to a URL that redirects.

items.title: PDPs in sitemap
items.detail: Add PDPs to the sitemap yourself or with AEM Commerce Prerender; they are left out by default.

items.title: Prerender thin pages
items.detail: If validators still see an empty PDP, configure AEM Commerce Prerender for full product HTML.

title: Product listing
summary: A product listing page (PLP) or category page on a Commerce storefront is an application part, built from the Product Discovery drop-in. The grid loads in the browser, so the page metadata, links and schema carry the SEO.

items.title: Discovery containers
items.detail: Compose the PLP from Product Discovery containers: SearchResults, Facets, SortBy and Pagination.

items.title: Page metadata
items.detail: Give each category page its own title, description and og tags in the first HTML, as for PDPs.

items.title: Schema on catalog pages
items.detail: Add schema.org JSON-LD such as BreadcrumbList to PLPs and validate it.

items.title: Consistent product links
items.detail: Generate every product tile link with getProductLink so URLs use the canonical lowercase form.

items.title: LCP after the grid
items.detail: If the first image comes from the catalog call, delay LCP candidate detection until the block has rendered.

items.title: Multi-store hreflang
items.detail: For several stores or locales, set hreflang and check catalog requests carry the cb cache key.

items.title: Breadcrumbs
items.detail: Show the category path as breadcrumbs so shoppers and crawlers see where the page sits.

title: Search results
summary: A search results page in EDS is usually the Block Collection search block or a widget reading the query index; on a storefront, Product Discovery runs product search. It has no canonical content, so focus on states and accessibility.

items.title: Pick the source
items.detail: Use the Block Collection search block, which reads /query-index.json unless a source is given.

items.title: Index has the fields
items.detail: Index title and description so results can show and match more than the URL.

items.title: Query in the URL
items.detail: Keep the term in the q parameter so results can be shared, bookmarked and reloaded.

items.title: Results announced
items.detail: Mark the results list as a polite live region so screen readers hear the update.

items.title: Empty state
items.detail: Show a no-results message, translated through placeholders, when nothing matches.

items.title: Labelled input
items.detail: Give the search input an accessible label, not only placeholder text.

items.title: Results not indexed
items.detail: Set robots noindex on the search page through page or bulk metadata.

items.title: Search term redirects
items.detail: Handle redirects for terms like /search?q= in code; the redirect sheet only matches paths.

summary: EDS serves 404.html from the root of the code repo for any URL with no content or code behind it. The boilerplate version shows the site header and footer, links home and reports the miss to OpTel.

items.title: 404.html in repo root
items.detail: Commit a 404.html at the code repo root; it replaces the minimal default 404 response.

items.title: Real 404 status
items.detail: Return HTTP 404 for missing pages, never a 200 or a redirect to the homepage.

items.title: Clear title
items.detail: Tell the visitor in the title and heading that the page was not found.

items.title: Branded header and footer
items.detail: Load the site header and footer on the 404 so visitors can navigate on.

items.title: Way home and back
items.detail: Offer a Go home link, and Go back when the visitor came from your own site.

items.title: Authorable content
items.detail: Load a fragment such as /fragments/404 so authors can edit the copy or localise it per site.

items.title: Track misses
items.detail: Keep the sampleRUM 404 call so OpTel shows which URLs and referrers produce 404s.

items.title: Redirect top misses
items.detail: Watch 404s after launch and add redirects for the popular ones in the redirects sheet.

title: Locale root
summary: A locale root such as /de/ is the home of one language or market folder. EDS recommends language first, then market, with localized nav, footer and placeholders in the folder and hreflang in the sitemap.

items.title: Language-first path
items.detail: Use a language folder first and an optional market below it, such as /en/ and /en/uk/.

items.title: Localized nav and footer
items.detail: Keep nav and footer documents in the locale folder so the header loads the right links.

items.title: Locale nav paths
items.detail: Set nav and footer metadata for /de/** in bulk metadata; the boilerplate defaults to /nav and /footer.

items.title: Correct html lang
items.detail: Replace the boilerplate's fixed lang en in scripts.js, or set html-lang metadata, per locale.

items.title: hreflang in sitemap
items.detail: Configure per-language sitemaps with hreflang and alternate paths rather than hreflang tags on each page.

items.title: x-default
items.detail: Set the default language in the sitemap config so entries get an x-default alternate.

items.title: Localized placeholders
items.detail: Keep placeholders in the language folder and override only what a market changes.

items.title: Let visitors choose
items.detail: Offer a language and market switcher and remember the choice; do not force geo redirects.
